decisions.reason: The dismantling joint sits close to the core pipeline business and was upgraded to its own page, so it costs little to keep and fits the firm's main customers, making it an option worth holding.

The public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it uses the existing powder-coating capacity at low marginal cost and serves municipal customers the firm already has, so its uncertain value justifies keeping the option open a while longer.

The waste bin with ashtray is a multi-model line distant from the core, and with no evidence after 2019 its value is still unresolved, but the low holding cost of using existing coating and fabrication suggests keeping it rather than abandoning it now.

The outdoor ashtrays are the furthest from the firm's infrastructure focus and so most at risk, but the line builds on shared coating capability and the same municipal channel, so dropping it before its results reveal more would throw away a cheap option.
